title: Oh My Ghost ! Oh My God!

title_lang.en: Oh My Ghost ! Oh My God!
title_lang.zh_hk: 怎麼可能我家的祖先是你家的鬼

synopsis:
Japanese pop singer Juliet travels to an Indigenous village in Taiwan to fulfill her late mother’s final wish of reconnecting with her ancestral roots. Joined by her childhood friend Amuy, Amuy’s boyfriend Demu and her skeptical manager,  she embarks on a journey into a sacred mountain.


After unknowingly violating ancient Indigenous taboos, the group becomes trapped in a mist-covered forest where vengeful spirits prey on their deepest fears. As terrifying supernatural encounters unfold, hidden secrets and unresolved ties to the past emerge, revealing that their journey was never a coincidence. To escape, they must confront both the ancient spirits and the truths they have long tried to bury.

synopsis_lang.zh_hk: 日本天后「歌姬茱麗葉」（渡邊直美 飾）竟然驚喜現身台灣山區？她的經紀人小羅（劉以豪 飾）一路臭臉卻又不得不跟著她入山~原來茱麗葉要展開追憶媽媽的尋根之旅。 茱麗葉找到昔日小學同學心嵐（小薰 飾）幫忙，她如今是當地的「柿子公主」，對部落熟門熟路，一口答應幫忙；心嵐找了男友陳萬德（蘇達 飾）組隊。一路上山走走停停，眼看天就要黑了，竟然直擊超自然現象，眾人走不出濃霧，陳萬德記起巫醫阿嬤以前的作法招式來引路，他們總算來到目的地─靈湖，但更可怕的卻才要來臨，在這裡，每個人內心的祕密竟然默默吸引了邪靈接近…….

cast: Naomi Watanabe, Jasper Liu, Soda Voyu, Esther Huang, Sakinu, Vivian Hsu
